findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product transfers to the client immediately upon creation as a work-for-hire before you receive full consideration or benefits under the arrangement.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Work Product shall transfer to the Client only upon full receipt of all consideration and performance due under this Agreement and the Manufacturing and Distribution Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a small modification before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, ownership of your work product transfers to the client immediately upon creation as a work-for-hire before you receive full consideration or benefits under the arrangement, and it is proposed that ownership of the Work Product shall transfer to the Client only upon full receipt of all consideration and performance due under this Agreement and the Manufacturing and Distribution Agreement. Thank you for your time and cooperation.
